summary: DouYu International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K to report its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results via a press release. The filing discloses total net revenues of RMB821.8M, gross profit of RMB129.4M, and net income of RMB27.4M, along with operational metrics such as average MAUs of 44.2M and mobile MAUs of 22.9M. Management commentary focuses on improved profitability, cost efficiency, and strategic investments in content and esports. There are no terms, stake, price, premium, or special-situation attributes. This is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event; it maps to a standard quarterly earnings release under US practice.
